report.title: Refuter-corps calibration: planted-defect recall and evidence-stripped verdict polarity
report.question: What are this program's refuter corps' measured recall on planted defects of known severity, and its measured default-verdict polarity when the evidence is insufficient - and does either number justify treating a refuter PASS as evidence? Spec 11062 requires refuters to default to REFUTED on insufficient evidence; the estate has measured the opposite tendency (of 225 audit findings actually checked, 42 percent were REFUTED while the producing agents self-rated confidence high on 89 percent).
report.claim_under_test: A refuter PASS/CONFIRMED is evidence only after measured recall and polarity; it is not evidence by role.
report.answer: No. On this confirmation-local mechanical corps, no refuter's CONFIRMED/PASS is justified as evidence. anchor-strict ARM-1 recall Wilson lower bound is 0.8754409629 but ARM-2 polarity-violation Wilson upper bound is 0.1379805758 (n=24), which is not < 0.05. eager-pass polarity-violation Wilson upper bound is 1.0. Hygiene-scanner and conservative-p0 errors are 100% false-pass. Production refuter runtime is absent; these numbers calibrate the local mechanical stand-in, not a missing cloud corps.
